title: MySQL settings
description: Root password and the few server settings a MySQL instance exposes.

rootPassword.title: Root password
rootPassword.description: Password of the root account, set once when the instance is created.

maxConnections.title: Max connections
maxConnections.description: Most client connections the server accepts at once.

innodbBufferPoolSizeMb.title: InnoDB buffer pool (MB)
innodbBufferPoolSizeMb.description: Memory the server reserves for caching table and index data.

binaryLog.title: Binary log
binaryLog.description: Keeps a log of every change. Change data capture tools need it. Uses more disk.
